title: Saints send LB Deion Jones to 49ers for RB Zamir White

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Saints send LB Deion Jones to 49ers for RB Zamir White
sources.description: The Saints are trading veteran linebacker Deion Jones to the 49ers in exchange for running back Zamir White, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
